EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}It finally feels like summer now that
it's the solstice!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} And summer means
lots of different bugs!
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}I'm gonna catch a whole mess of
bugs this summer,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Le {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}solstice d'été{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, c'est un peu le
point culminant de cette saison !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Et qui dit été, dit insectes !
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Ça veut dire qu'aujourd'hui, c'est
la journée parfaite pour partir à la
chasse aux insectes,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ah, ora con il solstizio
è finalmente arrivata l'estate!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
E con l'estate arrivano gli insetti!
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Quest'estate ne voglio prendere
un sacco,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Au jaaa, {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Mittsommer{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Jetzt ist
der Sommer endlich richtig da!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Und auch ganz viele Insekten!
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Ich fang diesen Sommer ganz, ganz
viele, das wird toll,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Gündönümü gelince yaz sonunda gerçekten
gelmiş gibi hissettiriyor!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Yaz demek de
bir sürü farklı böcek demek!
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Bu yaz tonla böcek yakalayacağım,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}There's no night today,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} so does it
still make sense to call dinner
"dinner"?
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}I think I'm gonna call it{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} "lunch the
second"!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Yeah,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} that sounds good!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Hoy no hay noche, por así decirlo.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
¿Significa eso que la cena ya no es
la "cena"?
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Creo que la voy a llamar{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} "segunda
comida".{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Sí, me gusta cómo suena.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}¡Y cómo sabe!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Vu que la nuit ne tombera pas
aujourd'hui,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} pourquoi on s'embête
encore à parler de « dîner » ?
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}On devrait plutôt appeler ça « le
déjeuner bis »,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} tu trouves pas ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Oggi non verrà la notte.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Secondo
te, stasera ha senso chiamare
la cena... "cena"?
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Sai che ti dico?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Penso proprio che
la chiamerò "pranzo 2, la vendetta"!
Sì,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} suona bene, eh?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Bugün gece yok,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} o zaman “akşam yemeği”ne
hâlâ akşam yemeği demek mantıklı mı?
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Bence adını{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} “ikinci öğle yemeği” koyacağım!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Evet,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} kulağa güzel geliyor!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Where does the moon go{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} during the 
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Summer Solstice{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}?{{TAG:0007:0001:}} I hope it's
enjoying its day off!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¿Y la luna qué hace durante el
solsticio de verano?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0007:0001:}} ¡Seguro que
está de vacaciones o durmiendo!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Où se cache la lune pendant le
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}solstice d'été{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Je parie qu'elle en
profite pour prendre des vacances !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Dove andrà la luna{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} durante il
solstizio d'estate?{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Beh, ovunque sia,
spero si stia godendo la vacanza!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Wo ist eigentlich der Mond an
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Mittsommer{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hoffentlich genießt er seinen freien
Tag und futtert was Leckeres!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Yaz Gündönümü{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} sırasında ay nereye
gidiyor?{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Umarım izin gününün tadını çıkarıyordur!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}If you're someone who can't sleep
when it's light out,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Summer
Solstice {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}has gotta be rough.
{{TAG:0003:0019:}}Yawwwn{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Lucky for me,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I don't
have that problem.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si eres de l{{TAG:000E:0006:04006F007300040061007300}} que no pueden dormir
sin oscuridad total,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} me da a mí que
lo vas a pasar mal en el solsticio.
{{TAG:0003:0019:}}Uaaah{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Yo, por suerte, no tengo
ese problema. {{TAG:0003:0021:}}¡Me duermo hasta
encima de una piedra!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Le {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}solstice d'été{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, ça doit être une
sacrée épreuve pour ceux qui ne
peuvent dormir que dans le noir.
{{TAG:0003:0019:}}Oouuhhhh{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Moi je suis bien content
de ne pas avoir ce genre de
problème !

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}El verano no empieza oficialmente
hasta que no ha pasado el solsticio.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}¿Y sabes lo que viene entonces?
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}¡El helado!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0004:}}¡Lo mejor del verano,
sin duda!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Comme le soleil ne se couchera pas
aujourd'hui, il va faire chaud jusqu'à
demain soir !
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Ça veut dire qu'il faut manger de
la glace pour rester hydraté !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}BEAUCOUP de glace !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Quando arriva il solstizio,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
significa che l'estate
è finalmente iniziata!
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}E con essa, arrivano anche
i gelati!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0004:}}Ah, il gelato è la parte
dell'estate che mi piace di più.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Wenn {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Mittsommer {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}rum ist, geht der
Sommer erst so richtig los!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Und das bedeutet: {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Eis für alle!!!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Eisessen ist ja wohl das
Allerwichtigste am Sommer, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}oder?

{{TAG:0003:0020:}}O da DONDURMA demek!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
